title: SAL dsc services
summary: Ledgerline sales discount services (dsc_get, dsc_save, dsc_search) serving screen SAL-DSC-10 for managing customer commercial discount agreements.
body:
The `services-sal-dsc` service group manages commercial discount agreements linked to customer ledger accounts in Ledgerline's sales module [^r1][^r3][^r9]. Introduced in version 7.0, these services power discount inquiries, record retrieval, and validation updates on screen [[screen-sal-dsc-10|SAL-DSC-10]] [^r5][^r9][^r14][^r18]. All endpoints require role authorization and session token authentication passed via the `X-LL-Session` header [^r10][^r15][^r18].

## Services

### dsc_get

Service `dsc_get` (DISCOUNT GET) is a read service exposed at `POST /ll72/svc/dsc_get` that retrieves discount agreement details from central pricing tables for screen [[screen-sal-dsc-10|SAL-DSC-10]] [^r2][^r6][^r9][^r10]. On the screen interface, it maps to Get (F3) and populates fields `CUST CD`, `DISC %`, `VALID TO`, and `STATUS` [^r2][^r5].

* **Required fields:** `dsc_cd` (string, DSC CD) [^r6][^r11].
* **Optional fields:** none [^r11].
* **Errors:** [[err-dsc-0001|ERR-DSC-0001]] when the discount identifier is not found, along with common errors `ERR-SEC-0001`, `ERR-SYS-0421`, `ERR-SYS-0422`, and `ERR-SYS-0503` [^r6][^r13].
* **Response:** Returns standard envelope fields `rc` (`S | W | E`), `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r12].
* **Source files:** `04_service_definitions/sales/dsc_get.yaml`, `MAN-SAL-72`, `MAN-SCR-72`, `MAN-SVC-72` [^r2][^r5][^r6][^r9].

### dsc_save

Service `dsc_save` (DISCOUNT SAVE) is a write service exposed at `POST /ll72/svc/dsc_save` that validates discount field values against customer ledger rules and writes new or amended terms to core database tables using stored procedure `sp_dsc_save` [^r3][^r7][^r14][^r17]. On screen [[screen-sal-dsc-10|SAL-DSC-10]], it maps to Save (F8) [^r5][^r7].

* **Required fields:** `cust_cd` (string, CUST CD) and `dsc_pct` (float, DISC %) [^r7][^r16].
* **Optional fields:** `valid_to` (date, VALID TO) [^r7][^r16].
* **Errors:** [[err-dsc-0001|ERR-DSC-0001]] if the customer account does not exist, fails structural validation, exceeds permitted category terms, or carries an administrative hold or stop [^r4]. Standard common errors include `ERR-SEC-0001`, `ERR-SYS-0421`, `ERR-SYS-0422`, and `ERR-SYS-0503` [^r17].
* **Source files:** `04_service_definitions/sales/dsc_save.yaml`, `MAN-SAL-72`, `MAN-SCR-72`, `MAN-SVC-72` [^r3][^r4][^r5][^r7][^r14].

### dsc_search

Service `dsc_search` (DISCOUNT LIST) is a read service exposed at `POST /ll72/svc/dsc_search` that renders an inquiry overlay of existing commercial discount agreements and associated customer codes on screen [[screen-sal-dsc-10|SAL-DSC-10]] [^r1][^r8][^r18]. On the screen, it is invoked via Search (F2 or Enter) [^r5].

* **Required fields:** none [^r19].
* **Optional fields:** `cust_cd` (string), `dsc_pct` (float), `valid_to` (date), and `status` (string) [^r8][^r19].
* **Errors:** Standard common errors `ERR-SEC-0001`, `ERR-SYS-0421`, `ERR-SYS-0422`, and `ERR-SYS-0503` [^r20].
* **Response:** Returns standard envelope fields `rc` (`S | W | E`), `err_cd`, `msg`, and `data` [^r20].
* **Source files:** `04_service_definitions/sales/dsc_search.yaml`, `MAN-SAL-72`, `MAN-SCR-72`, `MAN-SVC-72` [^r1][^r5][^r8][^r18].

r1.quote: dsc_search: Invokes the DISCOUNT LIST service. This routine displays an inquiry window listing existing discount schedules, allowing operators to locate specific commercial records

r2.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r2.quote: dsc_get: Invokes the DISCOUNT GET service. This routine reads the sales pricing tables and retrieves the full record details associated with the entered discount identifier

r3.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r3.quote: dsc_save: Invokes the DISCOUNT SAVE service. This routine validates all current screen entries, applies integrity checks against the customer ledger, and commits new or modified commercial discount terms

r4.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-SAL-72 Ledgerline 7.2 User Manual - Sales and Distribution v7.2.3.pdf
r4.quote: This message appears when the data entered does not conform to the account rules in Sales and Distribution, or when the account specified in CUST CD has an administrative hold applied.

r5.quote: Get F3 dsc_get Save F8 dsc_save Search F2/Enter dsc_search

r6.quote: dsc_get DISCOUNT GET Kind: read. Screen: SAL-DSC-10. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r7.quote: dsc_save DISCOUNT SAVE Kind: write. Screen: SAL-DSC-10. Since: 7.0. Procedures: sp_dsc_save.

r8.quote: dsc_search DISCOUNT LIST Kind: read. Screen: SAL-DSC-10. Since: 7.0. Procedures: none.

r9.quote:
service: dsc_get
title: DISCOUNT GET
module: SAL
kind: read
screen: SAL-DSC-10
since: "7.0"

r10.quote:
endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/dsc_get
auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r11.quote:
fields:
  - {name: dsc_cd, type: str, required: true, desc: DSC CD}

r12.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}

r13.quote:
errors:
  - {code: ERR-DSC-0001, msg: DISCOUNT NOT FOUND}

r14.quote: service: dsc_save title: DISCOUNT SAVE module: SAL kind: write screen: SAL-DSC-10 since: "7.0" endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/dsc_save

r15.quote: auth: session token in header X-LL-Session; the user's role must allow the service

r16.quote: - {name: cust_cd, type: str, required: true, desc: CUST CD} - {name: dsc_pct, type: float, required: true, desc: "DISC %"} - {name: valid_to, type: date, required: false, desc: VALID TO}

r17.quote: common_errors: - {code: ERR-SEC-0001, msg: ACCESS DENIED} - {code: ERR-SYS-0421, msg: "<FIELD> MANDATORY"} - {code: ERR-SYS-0422, msg: "UNKNOWN FIELD <FIELD> / BAD VALUE FOR <FIELD>"} - {code: ERR-SYS-0503, msg: "SERVER BUSY, TRY LATER"} procedures: [sp_dsc_save]

r18.quote: service: dsc_search title: DISCOUNT LIST module: SAL kind: read screen: SAL-DSC-10 since: "7.0" endpoint: POST /ll72/svc/dsc_search

r19.quote: - {name: cust_cd, type: str, required: false, desc: CUST CD} - {name: dsc_pct, type: float, required: false, desc: "DISC %"} - {name: valid_to, type: date, required: false, desc: VALID TO} - {name: status, type: str, required: false, desc: STATUS}

r20.quote: envelope: {rc: "S | W | E", err_cd: "error code when rc is E", msg: "short message in capitals", data: "result"}
